reference.episode_selection: Fixed complete UTC day with prior history; highest Scottish evening wind in the available winter operating season, otherwise the available period.
reference.agents_status: not yet trained; optimiser replay used as placeholder
reference.physics_description: Supplied simplified minimum-norm network flow simulator; not operational grid telemetry.

scenarios.name: b6_trip_windy_peak
scenarios.description: One Scotland–England boundary circuit trips at step 34 for the remaining seven hours. Synthetic canonical demand and weather; the optimiser is a network-aware heuristic.

scenarios.name: cold_snap
scenarios.description: Demand increases by 18% in every zone for twelve half-hours from step 30. Synthetic canonical data; no random incidents.

scenarios.name: nuclear_outage_low_wind
scenarios.description: Wind output is reduced to 25% nationally, with a 90% East England dispatchable-capacity outage from step 30. The simulator's generator_outage affects dispatchable plant, not nuclear; this limitation is retained explicitly.
